4301c56b256321e05359bae67ee73065.overview: In this dramatized account of his early law career in Illinois, Abraham Lincoln is born into a modest log cabin, where he is encouraged by his first love, Ann Rutledge, to pursue law. Following her tragic death, Lincoln establishes a law practice in Springfield, where he meets a young Mary Todd. Lincoln's law skills are put to the test when he takes on the difficult task of defending two brothers who have been accused of murder.
4301c56b256321e05359bae67ee73065.tagline: The story of Abraham Lincoln that has NEVER been told!

43029721423899ec96152afebee24fc4.overview: Hiller, a computer expert, was bribed by group of bank robbers to obtain details of the security system at a newly-built bank. Having obtained the information, he thought he'd seen the last of the robbers. But now they've traced him and his son to London. They hold the son hostage and force Hiller to decode the information about the alarm and then to take part in the robbery.
43029721423899ec96152afebee24fc4.tagline: They kidnapped his son. They forced him to steal 14 million dollars. Then they made their biggest mistake. They trusted him.

4316fcdd995559783263eebae36295ad.overview: Wrongfully convicted of murdering his wife and sentenced to death, Richard Kimble escapes from the law in an attempt to find the real killer and clear his name.
4316fcdd995559783263eebae36295ad.tagline: A murdered wife. A one-armed man. An obsessed detective. The chase begins.

4344b71d9c945f0932833558a0535121.overview: A stage director and an actress struggle through a grueling, coast-to-coast divorce that pushes them to their personal extremes.
4344b71d9c945f0932833558a0535121.tagline: Where there's a love, there's a way.

434c9a689739802adf514162daef330b.overview: During the Nazi occupation of Poland, an acting troupe becomes embroiled in a Polish soldier's efforts to track down a German spy.
434c9a689739802adf514162daef330b.tagline: The Picture Everyone Wants to See

439631404f18fde983058b2ee269fe94.overview: Young, impulsive Rosetta lives a hard and stressful life as she struggles to support herself and her alcoholic mother. Refusing all charity, she is desperate to maintain a dignified job.

439aebaccd945aa034c9a20ca805cba9.overview: Officer Chan Ka Kui manages to put a major Hong Kong drug dealer behind the bars practically alone, after a shooting and an impressive chase inside a slum. Now, he must protect the boss' secretary, Selina, who will testify against the gangster in court.
439aebaccd945aa034c9a20ca805cba9.tagline: From the master of action comes more screen excitement than you've ever seen.

43b9edf6778ec04efb1c2c7c854027da.overview: Expecting the usual tedium that accompanies a summer in the Catskills with her family, 17-year-old Frances 'Baby' Houseman is surprised to find herself stepping into the shoes of a professional hoofer—and unexpectedly falling in love.
43b9edf6778ec04efb1c2c7c854027da.tagline: First dance. First love. The time of your life.

43cfefe9153686a3399ee2ec2c9d32b4.overview: Fox, a former circus performer, wins the lottery of DM 500,000 and can now have the life and things that he has always wanted.  He enters an abusive relationship with wealthy industrialist Eugen in an attempt to climb the social ladder. His desperation for love and affection soon spirals into tragedy.

43e87742dd1d7584f3ecb8cfd2b196ff.overview: Augusto and Paulina have been together for 25 years. Eight years ago, he was diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Both fear the day he no longer recognizes her.

43ed5ff585cc8d30d29a2ee61a19f31f.overview: Claudia and Anna join Anna's lover, Sandro, on a boat trip to a remote volcanic island. When Anna goes missing, a search is launched. In the meantime, Sandro and Claudia become involved in a romance despite Anna's disappearance, though the relationship suffers from guilt and tension.

43ef16926b1cac060438e9ee65a405ba.overview: The revealing story of the 16th US President's tumultuous final months in office. In a nation divided by war and the strong winds of change, Lincoln pursues a course of action designed to end the war, unite the country and abolish slavery. With the moral courage and fierce determination to succeed, his choices during this critical moment will change the fate of generations to come.
